description: Adds a governed-SDD capability that distinguishes a lightweight, read-only project-status report from a conformance audit. The policy limits default evidence to mode confirmation, non-terminal queue state, direct dependency readiness, and Git state; it requires a stated evidence gap before expanding context. The operator cookbook supplies the corresponding narrow status prompt, while the Codex and Claude Code skills route explicit status requests through the policy.
delta: Add the Minimal read-only status policy section and replace the cookbook's broad status-report read list with the policy-directed minimal profile. Explicit status requests use this profile; audits remain unchanged.
verification: docs/CONTEXT_BUDGET_POLICY.md carries a MERIDIAN:BEGIN capability=minimal-read-only-status v1 marker that defines minimal sources, prohibited broad reads, and an evidence-gap gate for expansion

docs/OPERATOR_PROMPTS.md's read-only status prompt invokes the minimal profile and no longer mandates broad workflow, architecture, policy, ADR, specification, completion-report, or Git-history loading
The status profile explicitly distinguishes a status report from a conformance audit
